keyFindings.description: An adopted record (no Pending) held by an older build's claim that has not expired returns ClaimedElsewhere before any index write, so the adopted entry is never moved forward; the cursor passes it, the marker blocks the back-fill, and a refusal-only unlisted delivery is never asked for again. The deep review reproduced it with a test. Fix: on that path, when Pending is empty and not a dry run, Put pendingFor's entry (keyed at the claim's end) without writing the record, and return errPendingNotWritten if the Put fails.

A record an older build creates during a rollback that outlasts Lookback, whose requests GitHub only refuses, has no entry, is not listed, and is not back-filled while the marker stands (up to 72 h, which can outlast the delivery). The comment says a rollback and roll-forward inside three days is covered. Fix: let the new build detect a cursor an older build wrote (a field in cursorRecord the older build drops) and run the back-fill then; correct the comment.
backfillIndex's !written branch (a back-fill write that lost its compare-and-set must not mark the bucket) has no test that fails when it is removed (tester's mutation run).
openDue's stray margin has no test that fails when it is removed (tester's mutation run). The margin is also about one minute, not cursorOverlap, because keys are truncated to the minute.
